notes:
TL;DR: mid-market analytics SaaS with heavy in-app assistant + semantic search use. Trial on Hosted API looks good; now sizing Dedicated.  
- Contact: CTO Sara Nguyen (sara@embergrove.ai) + Head of Product Jonah Li.  
- Use-case: in-app conversational assistant for product analytics (mostly multi-turn chat + long context summarization), semantic search over product docs (embeddings), lightweight reranking on search results.  
- Hosted trial metrics (observed): avg tokens/request ~420 (chat 60%), embeddings calls 25%, rerank 15%. Token length distribution skewed: 30% short (<64), 50% mid (64-512), 20% long (>512).  
- Traffic pattern: weekday peak hours 09:00-18:00 PST, peak QPS observed on Hosted trial ~28 QPS (spikey), baseline ~6 QPS. Concurrent LLM sessions estimated 40-60 during peaks (includes API stream sessions).  
- Customer latency targets: p95 < 500ms for chat short sequences, p95 < 1s acceptable for long summarization. Throughput requirement: sustained 20 QPS with burst to 50 QPS. Cost sensitivity: mid-high; wants clear cost per 1M tokens and predictable monthly commit.  
- Requested Dedicated sizing: preliminary ask for 2-4 GPU workers (A100 80GB style) + autoscale to 6 for bursts; wants guidance on queueing/backpressure and batching settings.  
- SE notes (Miguel): batching helps embeddings-heavy workload; suggest mixed instance pool: 1-2 large-memory nodes for long context summarization (KV cache heavy) + 2-3 standard inference nodes for chat. Recommend enabling prefix KV caching for repeated user sessions.  
- Routing/fallback: prefer automatic fallback to quantized LLM variant for cost-sensitive routes (search rerank) and high-quality variant for assistant. Need model pinning features during rollout.  
- Security: SSO/SAML integration required, audit logs must be retained 12 months, KMS for key management, data residency: EU for a subset of customers (some EU tenants).  
- Commercial: expects annual commit; ballpark ARR ask $120k-$240k. Wants 30-day POC on Dedicated with credits if possible.  
- Quotes from call: "We need predictable token economics — surprises kill PM adoption."  
- Next steps: produce Dedicated capacity plan (QPS/concurrency/token mix-based) + formal pricing deck for EMEA and NA splits. Exec review scheduled week of 2026-03-22.  
- Known blockers: procurement queue (legal SLA negotiation), network peering (VPC), SOC2 evidence.  
- Links: pricing draft (drive://redwood/pricing/embergrove-dedicated-estimate-v1), security Q (drive://redwood/security/embergrove-security-questionnaire).  
- Action items assigned: Alicia to share Dedicated sizing doc by 2026-03-08; Miguel to provide detailed perf numbers; Jonah to confirm EU data residency scope.
